messages:
Jordan (People Ops): Hi @Maya L.	6 quick logistics check before your first day: can you do a remote I-9 verification or would you prefer in-person at the Oakland hub? We'll need passport OR DL + SSN card.
Maya L.: Hi Jordan	6 I'm local to Oakland so in-person sounds easier. What time should I come and where's reception? Also I haven't seen the Checkr link yet.
Jordan (People Ops): Great, in-person works. Come to 3rd floor reception at 09:15 on your start date and ask for People Ops. We'll run Section 2 in person. Checkr invite resent to maya.l@redwood.com just now	6 check spam if it's not in inbox.
Chris (Facilities): FYI building access: bring ID to concierge, they'll issue a visitor badge and escort you up. If you want a permanent badge, we'll swap it that afternoon once HR confirms I-9. Parking is limited; we can validate your parking pass if you need it.
Maya L.: Thanks! For direct deposit where do I enter bank info? I scanned the welcome packet but didn't see the PDF.
Jordan (People Ops): Direct deposit -> payroll portal: https://hr.redwood.com/payroll/setup (New Hire tab). You can also upload a voided check at the HR desk when you arrive.
onboarding-bot: Reminder: New-hire checklist pending: Checkr background, I-9 Section 2 (in-person), W-4, State tax form, benefits enrollment (30-day window).
Maya L.: Quick question about PTO: does accrual start immediately? Also is benefits enrollment mandatory day 1?
Jordan (People Ops): PTO accrues from day 1 but you gain full access to time-off request after 14 days. Benefits enrollment window is 30 days; you don't need to complete it on day 1 but we'd like you to join the benefits overview call at 10:45 to ask Qs.
IT Dispatch: Laptop will be provisioned and left with HR at reception. You'll get an MFA invite (Duo) to your phone when you first sign in. If you need temporary VPN access before laptop pick up, DM me and we'll spin a cloud dev VM.
Maya L.: Perfect. One last thing: can I bring a passport instead of DL? Prefer to use passport.
Jordan (People Ops): Passport is fine. We'll visually inspect originals and note for Section 2. If anything's off we'll coordinate a follow-up. See you at 09:15 at reception. :wave:
